Class PhysicalReplayHistory<S>

java.lang.Object
com.viaversion.viafabricplus.bedrock.movement.replay.PhysicalReplayHistory<S>
public final class PhysicalReplayHistory<S> extends Object
One bounded journal for an actor graph. Current input is executed by the ordinary client tick exactly once.
